title: Anthropic and OpenAI are hiring  weapons specialists to prevent ‘catastrophic misuse’ | Euronews
summary: Anthropic and OpenAI are hiring weapons specialists to prevent misuse of their AI technology, amidst legal and contractual challenges with the US government.
sentiment_reason: The hiring of weapons specialists and the ongoing legal disputes with the government indicate potential reputational risks and concerns over the use of AI in sensitive areas, contributing to a negative market sentiment.
